description: Server (mis)opens a stream beyond the negotiated max_streams cap. Only the server opens streams, so it is the CLIENT that must detect the cap violation and refuse the extra stream. OVERVIEW.md section 2.8 error table: 'OPEN beyond max_streams -> stream STREAM_LIMIT (repeat offence -> conn ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM)'; the same table's per-code list shows STREAM_LIMIT is client-sent only, which matches (only the server opens, so only the client is ever in a position to detect this).
